# routeros_interface_wifi_network_radio (Resource)
*<span style="color:red">The '/interface/wifi/network/radio' menu was verified on RouterOS 7.23; the exact minimum RouterOS version is not documented.</span>*

## Example Usage
```terraform
resource "routeros_interface_wifi_network_radio" "radio" {
  comment      = "Managed by OpenTofu"
  disabled     = true
  extra_labels = "example"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `___id___` (Number) <em>Resource ID type (.id / name). This is an internal service field, setting a value is not required.</em>
- `___path___` (String) <em>Resource path for CRUD operations. This is an internal service field, setting a value is not required.</em>
- `channel` (Map of String) Channel inline settings.
- `comment` (String)
- `configuration` (Map of String) Configuration inline settings.
- `disabled` (Boolean)
- `extra_labels` (String) Additional labels assigned to the radios matched by this entry, so that other entries can select them. Accepts a comma separated list of labels and the `+`/`-` prefixes.
- `labels` (String) Labels that select the radios this entry applies to. Accepts a comma separated list of labels, `all`, and the `+`/`-` prefixes to add or remove a label from the selection.
- `security` (Map of String) Security inline settings. Only `authentication_types` is accepted by this menu.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.

## Import
Import is supported using the following syntax:
```shell
#The ID can be found via API or the terminal
#The command for the terminal is -> :put [/interface/wifi/network/radio get [print show-ids]]
terraform import routeros_interface_wifi_network_radio.radio "*1"
```
